title: UK PPI — November 2026 producer price inflation (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET), goods-only, published into the MPC's meeting-end morning that its minutes will not cite
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/producerpriceinflationuknovember2026, re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page reads verbatim 'Producer price inflation, UK: November 2026', 'Release date: 16 December 2026 7:00am', 'This release is not yet published', and carries NO 'including services' rider. Cadence independently reproduced from the publisher's own previous-releases listing, fetched the same day: November 2025 data released 17 December 2025 — the November reference month lands on the third Wednesday of December, and 2026-12-16 is the third Wednesday. Filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: and no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2026-12-16 and proposed again by uk-ppi-2026-11-18, both 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-09, superseding BOTH proposals for this id — proposals/uk-ppi-2026-12-16.from-uk-cpi-2026-12-16.json and proposals/uk-ppi-2026-12-16.from-uk-ppi-2026-11-18.json — each read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md. PLACEMENT SURVIVES, THREE MECHANISMS REFUTED. Placement: 07:00 London, the same minute as uk-cpi-2026-12-16, on the day the December MPC meeting ends (BoE dates page fetched 2026-09-09: 'Thursday 17 December', 'MPC Summary and minutes' with NO Monetary Policy Report — the thinnest document set of the year). REFUTED 1 — the CPI proposal's claim that this print 'carries the cleanest read on SI 2026/987' because business electricity keeps its VAT: the ONS PPI QMI (re-fetched direct 2026-09-09, last revised 22 Oct 2025) states 'All index numbers exclude Value Added Tax (VAT)', so the tax is absent by measurement rule on BOTH sides, and PPI's energy panel is industrial/commercial supply outside Ofgem's domestic cap. REFUTED 2 — the PPI proposal's claim that this print's collection date is 'on or near 1 December 2026': the QMI's first-of-month rule applies to the REFERENCE month, so the November 2026 index prices on or near 1 NOVEMBER 2026 and publishes 45 days later. REFUTED 3 — the sibling ledger's forward claim that UK services producer prices publish on 12-16: the ONS release page for 'Producer price inflation, UK: December 2026 including services, October to December 2026' reads 'Release date: 20 January 2027 7:00am' (fetched direct). THE 16 DECEMBER PRINT IS GOODS-ONLY. AND THE MPC CHANNEL IS DECORATIVE FOR PPI: three Bank of England Monetary Policy Summary and minutes documents fetched direct 2026-09-09 (June 2026, July 2026, December 2025) contain ZERO occurrences of 'producer price', 'PPI', 'input prices', 'output prices' or 'factory gate' — and the December 2025 document is the exact analogue of this configuration, a meeting ending 17 December 2025 whose summary opens 'CPI inflation has fallen since the previous meeting, to 3.2%', the number ONS published at 07:00 that same morning, while UK PPI published in the same minute and went unmentioned. WHAT IS NEW HERE VS THE 11-18 SIBLING: the base month stops being flat. Aug/Sep/Oct 2025 input m/m ran 0.0/0.0/-0.1%; November 2025 ran +0.3% (GHIP 156.6 -> 157.1, ONS November 2025 bulletin, fetched). So the annual rate rises above the 18 November print only if first-week-November Brent in sterling gains more than ~3.3% on first-week-October, at the effective oil beta of ~9.2% measured from the publisher's own two months of product-group detail (crude group -20.9% -> input -1.9%; -18.0% -> -1.7%) — a third larger than crude's 6.9% basket weight. Base case: input 6.5-10.0% y/y centred ~8.3%, output 3.8-5.0% centred ~4.4%, the input-output gap widening past 3pp. Tiered LOW on the same grounds as its siblings: symbols: [], no rates- or sterling-keyed house playbook, attribution value only. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. Ledger: docs/research/events/uk-ppi-2026-12-16.md
